propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none must be validated by an advisory LLM criterion that judges whether the plan actually requires repository-file changes.
The no-file-impact criterion must route deterministically only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; scopes of 'paths', 'undeclared', missing, None, or unknown must not trigger the criterion.
The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON-serialized structured context into the Pass-1 LLM request, with empty reasons preserved as explicit empty strings.

Repository-file changes (source, config, test, documentation) must produce advisory contradiction findings; external-only deliverables must pass; insufficient evidence must produce non-blocking coaching.
Criterion applicability must be determined by the routing overlay validator; the orchestrator must pass ctx.state.get('file_impact_scope') and declared_reason into Pass-1's compositional extra_parts.
The generated criteria-guide must remain byte-identical across regenerations and contain only packaged criteria; no project-local overlays must leak into the public guide.
